Name: SH's Wild Animals-Chinese
Author: Iwannaberich
Description:
[b]介绍：[/b]SH's Wild Animals 是一个优秀的模组，在游戏中添加了多种野生动物，让鹈鹕镇更加生动可爱。它成为了我玩游戏时必不可少的模组之一。
SH's Wild Animals is an excellent mod that adds a variety of wild animals to the game to make it more lively and cute. It became one of the essential mods for me to play Stardew Valley.

仅包含翻译文本，请先下载原模组，然后按照教程安装汉化。

[b]安装：[/b]下载解压后，将zh.json文件放入 [b][u]Wild Animals\[CP] Wild Animals\i18n[/u][/b] 文件夹中。
